think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and allowed range/units. 2) Check whether the knob defines any sentinel ‘special’ numeric values (e.g., 0, -1) that switch the parameter into a qualitatively different mode such as disabling a feature or enabling an alternate behavior. 3) If such sentinel values exist and are valid settings, classify as a special knob and record the special value(s); otherwise classify as not special.
